title: Warm and Cozy Ranch Home
description:
Have fun with the whole family at our home located 30 minutes from Nashville, minutes to Old Hickory Lake, and in a safe and family friendly neighborhood. 

Our home is situated on a corner lot with a nice yard to throw ball in or take a stroll/ bike ride around the area. You can walk to a selection of restaurants or the Publix for groceries. 

Our home has three bedrooms with comfortable mattresses and cozy linens. 

We also have games, outdoor equipment, and a fire pit for family bonding.

The space
Three bedrooms with a king bed, queen bed, and a daybed with trundle. 

Two full baths with a selection of quality shampoos and body wash. 

Fully stocked kitchen with a selection of spices, oils, and pantry staples, plus pots and pans. 

We also have a coffee pot with a carafe and single serve pods, and a hot water kettle for teas. 

We have a dedicated workspace with free WiFi located in the sitting room that has games and books.

Guest access
Access to entire home and yard minus the garage which is for the host only.

Other things to note
We have a driveway that accommodates two to three cars.
